issues.what: USA keyframe 1890 ('ok', Cliopatria shape without Great Lakes waters) snaps 779 cells (Lake Michigan, Huron, Superior, Alaska) to nobody; the 1898 shape does the same. The dossier's own 1880 shape holds them.
issues.decision: patched (and a dossier request: keyframes 1900 onward have the same gap, Michigan 405 cells nobody in every anchor to p2000)

issues.what: Bosnia and Herzegovina (180 cells) is nobody from the austria-hungary_1880 keyframe on, so austria-hungary/ledger/2 (occupation of Ottoman Bosnia) draws nothing; 1890-1907 grey
issues.decision: patched: Ottoman sovereignty restored in January 1890 and the occupation restarted in February (drawn Ottoman land hatched by Austria-Hungary); root cause is in p1880-p1889

issues.what: french-africa_1897 and _1898 keyframes omit the Mossi plateau (conquered 1896), Gwiriko (Bobo-Dioulasso 25 Sep 1897) and Bagirmi (protectorate 1897) that the Mossi, Gwiriko and Bagirmi ledgers give to french-africa; the snaps threw 464 + 218 cells to nobody (Burkina Faso 1242 of 1301 cells nobody in 1899)
issues.decision: patched (keyframes widened); french-africa_1900 will drop them again, see problems

issues.what: ethiopian-empire keyframes 1890, 1895, 1898 are Cliopatria shapes without the conquests the ledger and page date earlier (Arsi, Wollega 1886, Harar and Illubabor 1887, Gurage 1889; Bale, Sidamo, Ogaden, Welayta from 1891; Kambata, Gofa, Wollamo; Borana, Beni Shangul, Gimirra 1898); snaps removed 402, 867 and 278 cells (the Ogaden, 864 cells, went from Ethiopian in 1891 to nobody in 1895)
issues.decision: patched (three keyframes widened to the ledger regions)

issues.what: ethiopian-empire/ledger/48 (Massonge and Gimirra, 1898) skipped: 'Massango' does not resolve
Khedivate of Egypt keeps a strip of Harar and Afar land (78-125 cells in Ethiopia) after leaving the Somali coast in 1884; the size rule gives it to Egypt wherever Ethiopia's keyframes claim it
issues.decision: patched (ruling for Ethiopia inside modern Ethiopia, settled 122 cell-years)

issues.what: Dhofar (Zufar, 445 cells) is nobody from 1880 to 1897 although the Oman ledger regains it in January 1879; the 1898 keyframe snap adds it back
issues.decision: patched (bridge event at the start of the window, confidence 2); root cause in p1880-p1889

issues.what: Cuba from December 1898: the island is drawn as United States land 'occupied by the Republic of Cuba' (roles reversed; united-states-of-america/ledger/83 names a republic that does not exist until 20 May 1902, and captaincy-general-of-cuba/ledger/14 hands the land to the US although 'Spain relinquished all claim of sovereignty')
issues.decision: dossier request (a three-event patch that closed the reversed occupation, released the land to nobody and reopened the occupation was tried in the trial and rejected: cuban-nationalists_1898 then took half the island and the other half showed plain grey)

issues.what: congo-free-state / mahdist-state conflicts (822 cell-years, Congo wins Central Equatoria and Orientale) and the 1895 snap adding the Lado Enclave
issues.decision: fine as drawn: the dossier dates the 1894 lease of the Lado Enclave and Chaltin's Rejaf of 17 February 1897; the smaller state winning is the leased claim

issues.what: kingdom-of-kasanje / portuguese-empire (367 cell-years) and kingdom-of-kongo / portuguese-empire; Angola interior drawn as portuguese-empire direct while the coast is portuguese-angola (two tints of one green)
issues.decision: fine as drawn for borders (Anglo-Portuguese treaty frontiers, claimed); the split between portuguese-empire and portuguese-angola is a hierarchy-level oddity left for the orchestrator

issues.what: Portuguese occupation of the western Lozi land from 1895 (474 cells hatched to 1899)
issues.decision: fine as drawn: dossier cites the Barotseland page ('In 1895, the Portuguese occupied some of the Lozi's western territory')

issues.what: Mahdist State drawn as holder of the Nile valley contest cells at end of 1898 after Omdurman (2 September 1898)
issues.decision: fine as drawn: Dongola, Abu Hamad and Omdurman go to British Africa by event; the Khalifa kept a remnant until Umm Diwaykarat (November 1899)

issues.what: emirate-of-jabal-shammar / ottoman-empire conflict 1895 (308 cells; Medina 43, Tabuk 24, Al Jawf 86) and the 1895 snap adding Riyadh and Hasa-side cells
issues.decision: left: the dossier's Tayma/Khaybar/Al Jawf discs rest on its own pages; no page opened here either dates or contradicts them

issues.what: Skipped events: lagos-colony/ledger/1 (Ilaro, about 11 cells) and united-states-of-america/ledger/84 (Wake Island, smaller than a cell)
issues.decision: left: pages silent on a gazetteer name for Ilaro; Wake Island moves no land

issues.what: Kenya and Uganda are nobody in 1890-1894 (imperial-british-east-africa-company holds only Mombasa; Buganda is its vassal from 1891); the sphere is not drawn
issues.decision: fine as drawn: the dossier models the company as Mombasa and its mainland; british-africa takes the protectorates in 1894-1895

issues.what: Chukotka (411 cells of the Chukchi Autonomous Okrug) is nobody in every year after the 1778 gain is snapped away, so Russia has a grey hole at its north-east tip
issues.decision: dossier request (every russian-empire keyframe is an unadjusted Cliopatria shape; a window patch would flip in and out at each keyframe)

issues.what: Other unmapped land: Sulawesi interior (about 520 cells) and Greenland (7948 of 8243 cells) are nobody; Sahara and Arabian deserts nobody
issues.decision: left: pages silent here and the Sahara/Arabia gaps are unclaimed land

issues.what: Tigray (166 cells) goes Ethiopian to Italian (1890) to nobody (1895, italian-africa_1895 snap) to Ethiopian (1898, ethiopian-empire_1898 snap) instead of changing at Adwa (1896) and Addis Ababa (October 1896)
issues.decision: left: pages silent in this run (no page opened on the Eritrean frontier)

dossier_requests.what: make keyframes 1890 ('ok') and 1900, 1905, 1908, 1911 onward 'adjust' with the full-extent correction used for 1880 (country plus the Alaska region), so the Great Lakes waters inside Michigan and Wisconsin stay American
dossier_requests.why: 405 Michigan cells (and Wisconsin's) are nobody in every anchor from p1900 to p2000; this patch covers only 1890-1899

dossier_requests.what: widen every keyframe from 1782 on with Chukotka (Chukchi Autonomous Okrug, 411 cells), which the 1778 gain adds and the next unadjusted Cliopatria shape drops
dossier_requests.why: grey hole at Russia's north-east tip through the whole empire

dossier_requests.what: ledger/14 (December 1898 loss of Cuba) should give the island to nobody (or the occupation should be recorded by the US as occupation of nobody's land); united-states-of-america/ledger/83 then occupies land of the future Republic of Cuba
dossier_requests.why: the draft draws Cuba as US land occupied by the Republic of Cuba, which is born in 1902; 'Spain relinquished all claim of sovereignty' and 'Cuba was to be occupied by the United States'

dossier_requests.what: the 1880 keyframe says Bosnia is occupation land (ledger) but the keyframe's removal leaves it nobody's, so the ledger occupation has nothing to hatch; either keep Bosnia in the keyframe as occupied land or have the Ottoman dossier hold it
dossier_requests.why: root cause of the Bosnia grey from 1880 to 1907 (this patch repairs 1890-1899 only); austria-hungary_1900 will snap Bosnia direct at 1900

dossier_requests.what: keyframes 1900 and 1903 onward need the Mossi plateau, Gwiriko (Burkina Faso) and Chari-Baguirmi, the lands the Mossi, Gwiriko and Bagirmi ledgers give to french-africa
dossier_requests.why: french-africa_1897 and _1898 are overridden here; french-africa_1900 (Cliopatria 1900 shape) will drop them again

problems: Seam: the Bosnia events (events/0-1), the Dhofar event (events/3), the USA overrides and the Burkina overrides are applied inside 1890-1899 but their cause lies in p1880-p1889 (austria-hungary_1880 and sultanate-of-oman_1880 snaps); if the p1880-p1889 agent patches the same land, the events here merge harmlessly (gain over land already held moves nothing; the occupation merges into the open one).

Seam: end anchor p1900 changes 2861 owners against the published draft (Bosnia occupied, Burkina French, Ogaden Ethiopian, Dhofar Omani, Great Lakes American). The p1900-p1909 agent should expect snaps at 1900 from austria-hungary_1900 (Bosnia direct), french-africa_1900 (Burkina and Bagirmi dropped) and united-states-of-america_1900 (lakes dropped again).

Ethiopia override overlaps the Somali coast claims: ethiopian-empire / sultanate-of-hobyo now 170 cell-years (Hobyo wins by size) and dervish-state / ethiopian-empire 44 (Dervish wins); the Ogaden-Hobyo frontier is therefore settled by the size rule in 1895-1899; no page opened gives it.

Label: the Romania dossier prints as 'United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia' from 1881 to 1918 (identity name 'Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918'); Serbia, Greece and Montenegro print equally long names; the legend labels could use a short name.
Cuba: attempted patch rejected (see issues); the current draft keeps the reversed occupation (US land hatched in the Republic of Cuba's colour) for December 1898 to 1902.

Trial note: events/0 uses month 1 and events/1 month 2 so the Ottoman gain comes before the occupation; the ethiopian-empire_1895/1898/1890 overrides contain the dossier ledger's own regions (Illubabor, Gurage, Hadiya, Wollega, Arsi, Harar, Bale, Sidamo, Ogaden, Welayta, Kambata, Gofa, Wollamo, Borana, Beni Shangul, Gimirra); Hadiya is dated 1879-1884 by the page, 1889 by the ledger (both before 1890).
hierarchy: no row confirmed wrong; cretan-state of ottoman-empire (1898) and hunza-and-nagar of british-raj (1891) show 0 cells in the packet, which this run did not trace to a page.
